name: Wisconsin

fees.note: Oversize-only permit: $15 overlength only, $20 overwidth or overheight, $25 overwidth and overheight (built from this line + the two +$5 lines). Overweight permits include any oversize (see overweight line).
+$5 for overwidth (part of the $20/$25 oversize fee).
+$5 for overheight (part of the $20/$25 oversize fee).
Overweight single trip (includes any oversize): $20 up to 90,000; $35/$45/$55/$65/$75/$85 per 10,000 lb band to 150,000; then +$10 per 10,000 lb or fraction (table here stops at 500,000 lb).
$10 per WisDOT region (district) when size/weight requires regional route review, and $10 per structure review when gross weight requires it. Not predictable from dimensions alone.

restrictions.text: No oversize travel 4-8 PM in Columbia, Dane, Milwaukee, Rock and Waukesha counties on Sundays, Fridays from the 4th Friday in May through Labor Day, restricted-travel holidays and the day before. Milwaukee County expressways: no oversize Mon-Thu 6-9 AM and 3-6 PM, Fri 6-9 AM, Fri/Sun 3-8 PM. Madison Beltline: no oversize Mon-Fri 6-9 AM and 3-6 PM.

Over 12 ft wide, 13'6" high or 150 ft long: no travel in darkness, Saturday noon to Sunday sunrise, Sunday 4-8 PM, or from noon the day before to sunrise the day after each restricted-travel holiday (WisDOT publishes the yearly list).

Over 12 ft wide, 13'6" high or 150 ft long: no travel in darkness, Saturday noon to Sunday sunrise, Sunday 4-8 PM, or from noon the day before to sunrise the day after each restricted-travel holiday (WisDOT publishes the yearly list).

Overweight-only (not oversize) loads may travel 24 hours a day including weekends and holidays unless the permit says otherwise.
Permits over 14 ft wide, 14'6" high or 150 ft long are not valid on most of the Milwaukee County expressway system; over 16 ft wide not on Interstates unless the permit specifically authorizes it.

notes: Escort grid is minimum; WisDOT may add escorts for route complexity, turns or traffic. Escort also required whenever the load crosses the centerline on two-way roads or the left edge of the right lane on multilane highways (lane-width dependent, not modeled).
Height over 16 ft: front pole vehicle in addition to grid escorts, but total private escorts including the pole car never exceed two.
Single-trip maximums: single vehicle 50 ft, mobile crane 60 ft; other dimensions depend on the load and route. No published 'superload' class in Trans 254.
Permits are valid only on State, US and Interstate highways; local roads need local permits.
